program Construct a logical derivation one inference at a time.
use profile=verified.
use context=none, coercion=strict.
given premises: Any.
given goal: Any.
given proof_rules: Any.
let session0 = proof_session_start(premises, goal).
let raw_frontier1 = proof_session_frontier(session0).
let frontier1 = {goal: raw_frontier1.goal, premises: raw_frontier1.premises, lines: raw_frontier1.lines, next_id: raw_frontier1.next_id, complete: raw_frontier1.complete, steps_left: 3}.
ask candidate1: Record {rule: one of {premise, assume, implies_intro, implies_elim, and_intro, and_left, and_right, or_left, or_right, or_elim, false_elim}, args: List of Text length 0..5, formula: Any} "Propose exactly one next inference toward the goal in frontier1. Follow proof_rules. Use only named premises or prior lines in the frontier. The host assigns next_id and checks every inference. Do not return a proof, state, id or new premises. Proposition text is opaque; no unstated facts are available." from frontier1, proof_rules with context=none, effort=low, route=escalate, retries=2, budget=24000
let inference1 = proof_session_append(premises, goal, session0, candidate1).
ensure inference1.valid else retry because [inference1.error, inference1.hint].
if inference1.complete then
  let certificate = inference1.certificate.
else
  let raw_frontier2 = proof_session_frontier(inference1.state).
  let frontier2 = {goal: raw_frontier2.goal, premises: raw_frontier2.premises, lines: raw_frontier2.lines, next_id: raw_frontier2.next_id, complete: raw_frontier2.complete, steps_left: 2}.

    ask candidate3: Record {rule: one of {premise, assume, implies_intro, implies_elim, and_intro, and_left, and_right, or_left, or_right, or_elim, false_elim}, args: List of Text length 0..5, formula: Any} "Propose exactly one next inference toward the goal in frontier3.
